svg.title: Bowfin makes the boundaries visible
svg.desc: Know what is guaranteed, proven, trusted, and unsafe. COMPILER KNOWS: ownership, valid references, effect restrictions. Structural guarantees. VERIFIER PROVES: contracts, invariants, selected properties. Under stated assumptions. EXPLICIT TRUST: external assumptions, FFI boundaries, hardware facts. Auditable dependencies. UNSAFE: escape hatches, isolated regions, review boundaries. Where guarantees stop.

path.aria-label: Know what is guaranteed, proven, trusted, and unsafe.
